# Runtime dependencies for the CI and local security scripts.
#
# zstandard is required, not optional: .blend files in this repository are raw
# Zstandard frames, and blend_scanner.py refuses to report a clean result
# (exit 2) when it cannot decode a container. A runner without this package
# would silently skip every .blend it could not read, so keep it installed
# everywhere the scanner runs: CI, the pre-push hook and local shells.
zstandard>=0.22
